packageRules.description: These are AndroidX and Google Play Services artefacts, which live in Google's Maven repository. The module build.gradle files declare no repositories block, so Renovate falls back to Maven Central, cannot find them, and reports a lookup failure for each. They are pinned deliberately: one version is shared across modules on the app's classpath, and they move with the Expo and React Native SDK upgrade rather than on their own.
An Expo SDK bump has to move every expo package together via `npx expo install --fix`, then be rebuilt and tested on a device. Approve these by hand from the dependency dashboard.

React Native and its native companions are pinned by the Expo SDK, so they ride in the expo bump instead of arriving as standalone pull requests that cannot be merged. Each one alone either fails to resolve (react-native-reanimated 4.6 peers react-native-worklets 0.12.x) or sits outside the SDK's tested matrix, so merging one without the SDK move breaks the release build.
Gradle dependencies come from Expo's prebuild output and changing them needs a native rebuild plus an on-device test, so they wait for approval too.
Every other major version waits for a deliberate decision rather than arriving as a pull request.
